result.title: Reading Decisions Before Spans: Efficient Generative Verification
result.summary: A developer checking an assistant's report may need only an alarm that a claim is unsupported. A generative verifier, however, can continue decoding to quote and classify the errors. We study how much of that output is needed to recover its decision. In a frozen 2B span verifier, the choice between an empty error list and its first object precedes all localization. Native8 stops generation at this branch. The preceding seven syntax tokens are fixed, so Prefill1 supplies them as input and generates only the unrestricted branch token, using the same native instruction. On 2,015 code-agent TEST responses, Prefill1 reduces eager resident service by 84.84% relative to full generation, with released-reference F1 of 83.43 versus 83.41. It saves 31.98% over Native8 even though their logical token totals are identical. Under default compiled execution, the extra saving is 6.74-26.73% on the complete workload, with small decision changes. Controlled evidence interventions and first-location decoding establish what these shorter readouts retain and what requires further generation.

AI.brief_summary: 在冻结的 2B span verifier 上研究生成式验证的决策何时形成：判断「有无错误」的分支 token 早于全部定位输出，因此提出 Prefill1 只生成该分支 token，在 2,015 条 code-agent 响应上将常驻服务成本降低 84.84%，F1 基本不变。
AI.relevance_reason: 「决策先于证据陈述被读出」的设定，可为 LVR 中停止决策、生成多少输出才够判断及验证器成本分摊提供可核查线索；但对象是纯文本代码校验，其对视觉证据的筛选是否可迁移仍待核查。
